reviews.text:
I cannot recommend them enough! Shiloh was an anxious puppy, but she was also extremely stubborn and such a little firecracker. I wanted her to gain confidence while building a strong foundation of obedience, and I can already see so much progress.

She was obviously very excited when she first came home, but even during her take-home lesson, I could see such a difference in her behavior. She is more confident, listens so much better, and is much easier to manage. She still has all the personality that makes her Shiloh, which I love, but now I have the tools to work with her and help her settle down when she gets overly excited.

I am especially grateful that they did not just train her and send her home. They taught me how to continue working with her so we can keep building on everything she learned. I already feel like she will be able to go more places, experience more, and have a happier life because of this training. I am so grateful for everything they did for both of us!

As a member of a rescue we sometimes have a need for behavioral training.  We have used Tail To Tail on numerous occasions and the results have been outstanding!  No behavior is too much for this trainer and their practices work!   I love the fact that it’s a board and train and the follow up is a true bonus!!!  Worth every penny!

Tail to Tail saved my household 14 yrs ago! I’ve worked with them ever since.  I am involved in rescue and have multiple dogs come through my house. Their training methods have given me the skills to work with the easy ones. When I get a harder foster I give them a call! They do amazing work and you can trust Your dog to their care.

Let me tell you a tale about Tail to Tail!! They have shown incredible patience with my foster dog, Pico, and such dedication to helping my partner and I get him ready for his forever home. Prior to Pico going, he was reactive to EVERYTHING. But Tail to Tail gave us the tools to help him be a calm, confident and loving dog. He was always a sweet boy but now can let that show in every setting. It has truly changed our household and Oscar (our cat) is the most grateful!! Their monthly group classes are also a great way to keep us accountable which is arguably the hardest part. We cannot rate them highly enough. Also, if anyone is interested in adopting Pico, please apply at Sauver Des Chiens, he is incredibly well trained <3

We have used Tail to Tail Training for both training and boarding. They are so knowledgeable and kind and really helped us with both our pups. We needed some assistance with our (late) Berner’s behaviors after the birth of our first child and noticed a huge improvement after a stay with Christine and Toni. More importantly, they taught my husband and I how to continue the training and be consistent at home! Our new pup loves to go on holidays at Tail to Tail and we like that he can do “refresher” work while he’s there! Thank you Christine and Toni!

We just started training yesterday and, in just twenty four hours, our undisciplined, easily distracted, 10 month old puppy has learned the following commands, "sit," "place," "leave it" and "let's go." Christine and Toni are amazing at what they do. We have only just begun with our training,  but to see results so quickly in a ten month old puppy is amazing. I love the fact that they explain every step of their training and make certain that you understand what they are doing and why they are doing it. Christine trained under Cesar Millan many years ago, and her expertise and professionalism is it true reflection of learning from the best.
Do you have a dog that suffers from Anxiety,  Aggression please contact tail to tail training ask for Joseph Fernandez He is the top of the top Excellent!!!!
They do AMAZING work!!! And some of the kindest people I have ever met. I highly recommend!!

We recently reached out to Tail to Tails to train our "rambunctious" Malinois/Shepherd mix, 1 years of age. Tail to Tails was recommended to my vet daughter, who has a client who's used them to train over 9 dogs of theirs. Maverick was put in Joseph's care for 3 weeks (he needed an extra week). We were at our wits end with this rescue dog, dumped (by some irresponsible humans in a nearby neighborhood) whom our daughter literally ran across (along w/a brother of his).  Finding no availability in a no kill shelter for these 2, my husband & I took them in (even though we were happy w/the pets God had already provided to us). We are in our 60's and were not seeking to "adopt" two large dogs.
All we can say is: WOW, 3 weeks with soft spoken Joseph's training skills made the difference we needed to now have a well mannered dog.  Maverick is now wearing an E-collar during the day (which serves to gently remind him of his new manners); but even when not on, he usually responds to his new commands (which are less than 10 words). We can walk him on his lead leash and not be pulled, yay. He can stay in place and not jump on our granddaughter or someone coming to visit. We love the new Maverick; THANK YOU JOSEPH!
We will continue to work with him to bring the best of him out. And our pitbull mix now mimics Maverick's actions. Thank you for helping to bring some peace to our home. We HIGHLY RECOMMEND TAIL TO TAILS (peace is worth a small cost)! We could tell that Joseph, Toni and Christy love dogs (and cats) and want the best for them and their owners❣️

Tail to Tail (Christine and Toni) took on a stray dog we rescued from the streets and transformed this sweet but large and strong dog into a well behaved and obedient dog.  She sits, stays in place, walks nicely on a leash, has been tested positively with cats and also now knows how to play with other dogs.  We could not be more delighted with the transformation of Daisy Mae.   In addition to training Daisy Mae, they trained us on how to work with her.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

I cannot say enough great things about Christine, and the trainers at Tail to Tail Training. I was looking for a trainer for our 2 year old male bull terrier and his 5 year old brother, and they were recommended to me by a Facebook dog group. I had to do my own research of course, because I was in dire need of getting our issues worked out, and required  experts who had experience with the breed. I was turned away by many trainers because of their breed and was told- " these were just issues with the breed itself, and could not be trained out or even attempted to." I spoke with Christine who assured me she had many years or experience with Bull Terriers and that whilst they are stubborn - they can definitely improve and learn manners and commands. I waited a year to save up and figure out good timing for us to drop them off for board and train- and also for me and my husband to mentally prepare as we were really stressed about leaving our dogs. One of our dogs had been kicked out of several daycares, and we never really had success with anyone being able to handle his rowdy self. Christine and her trainers were extremely compassionate and understanding of our nervousness and helped us talk through the issues we wanted addressed and what concerned us. We were able to get updates on Facebook and by text about how the dogs were doing and that made it so much easier for us to relax while they were gone. At pick up we were absolutely blown away with the improvement in both dogs- and so relieved that we found people who understood them and their issues. These trainers are true professionals who take their time to understand what's truly going on with the dogs they train, and the end result is a reflection of their dedication and care. My husband and I are beyond pleased and so grateful that we found them.  They will both be back for boarding in the future and group classes to maintain and build their skill set.

I could not be more pleased with #Tailtotailtraining. I just picked up my 5 month old mix bread shelter rescue who was feeding off a cat before being rescued by Pasadena Animal Shelter. The work Toni and Christine put into this dog is unbelievable and so appreciative. I was so sad Angel wasn't a snuggle bunny, but then Christine taught me how to get a few good pets in before she runs off. And Toni!! She taught me the difference between yes and YES!!!!!! Angel is so much calmer, more understood and understandable. I'm so happy with the outcome and look forward to our refreshers every month. Thank you TailToTail!!!
